title: Allative Pronouns: Towards Me / To My Place

sections.content:
The allative case (*-hoz / -hez / -höz*, meaning 'to / toward') forms personal pronouns on the stem **hozzá-**:
- **hozzám** = to me / to my place
- **hozzád** = to you / to your place
- **hozzá** = to him / to her / to it
- **hozzánk** = to us / to our place
- **hozzátok** = to you all / to your place
- **hozzájuk** = to them / to their place
